purpose: This table provides hourly ASOS weather observations at the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for January through June 2013, sourced from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet via the nycflights13 weather dataset, feeding weather-aware analyses of flight operations.
usage: Join to flight records on origin and time_hour (a UTC instant) to align weather with departure or arrival times; local year/month/day/hour fields are retained for display but time_hour is authoritative for ordering and joins. Consumers must explicitly handle nulls in wind_gust (74.6% missing), pressure (11.5% missing), and wind_dir (1.7% missing) rather than assuming zero or average values.
limitations: wind_gust is populated in only about a quarter of rows (null_rate 0.745505) and should not be treated as reliably available; pressure is missing in 11.5% of rows and wind_dir in 1.7%. No duplicate rows were observed in bronze (duplicate_row_rate 0.0 across 13014 rows) so no deduplication logic was applied. Capture-tool metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped as out of scope for business use.
